# useStream

Runs a streaming request and accumulates its chunks into a value, such as the text of an AI reply. The stream can
be stopped and restarted; stopping, restarting or unmounting aborts the request. When chunks arrive densely
(hundreds per second), the value is updated at most once per animation frame.
Read the chunks with `readSSE` or `readTextStream`, or return any async iterable.

**Category**: AI · **Common uses**: Streaming AI replies, long-running generation with a stop button, any `text/event-stream` endpoint

## Import

```ts
import { useStream } from 'vellum-ui'
```

## Basic usage

`request` returns the events of the response (here a simulated endpoint; in a real page, `fetch` with the same
`signal`). The text grows as events arrive; "Stop" aborts the request and keeps what has arrived.

```tsx
export function Basic() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal) => readSSE(fakeSSE(ANSWER, { signal }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  const streaming = reply.status === 'streaming'
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2} align="center">
        {streaming ? (
          <Button onClick={reply.stop}>Stop</Button>
        ) : (
          <Button type="primary" onClick={() => reply.start()}>
            Generate
          </Button>
        )}
        <Pill tone={TONES[reply.status]}>{reply.status}</Pill>
      </Inline>
      <Text as="p">{reply.value || '—'}</Text>
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## States

### Failure and retry

When the connection breaks, `status` becomes `error`, `error` holds the reason and the text received so far is
kept. Arguments of `start` are passed on to `request`.

```tsx
export function Failure() {
  const reply = useStream({
    request: (signal, failAfter?: number) =>
      readSSE(fakeSSE(ANSWER, { signal, failAfter }), { signal }),
    initial: '',
    reduce: appendDelta,
  })
  return (
    <Stack gap={3}>
      <Inline gap={2}>
        <Button onClick={() => reply.start(40)} disabled={reply.status === 'streaming'}>
          Generate (fails halfway)
        </Button>
      </Inline>
      <Text as="p">{reply.value || '—'}</Text>
      {reply.status === 'error' && (
        <ErrorState
          size="sm"
          message={reply.error instanceof Error ? reply.error.message : undefined}
          onRetry={() => reply.start()}
        />
      )}
    </Stack>
  )
}
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Description | Default | Required |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `request` | `( signal: AbortSignal, ...args: A ) => AsyncIterable<T> \| Promise<AsyncIterable<T>>` | Starts the request and returns the chunks, such as `readSSE(await fetch(url, { signal }), { signal })`. Pass `signal` on to `fetch` and the reader: it is aborted when the stream is stopped, restarted, or the component unmounts. The arguments after `signal` are the arguments of `start`. | — | Yes |
| `initial` | `V` | The value before the first chunk; `start` and `reset` return to it. | — | Yes |
| `reduce` | `(value: V, chunk: T) => V` | Folds a chunk into the value, such as `(text, e) => text + JSON.parse(e.data).delta`. Return a new value instead of changing the old one. An exception fails the stream. | — | Yes |
| `onDone` | `(value: V) => void` | Called with the final value when the stream finishes normally (not when it is stopped). | — | No |
| `onError` | `(error: unknown, value: V) => void` | Called when the request or `reduce` fails, with the error and the value received so far. | — | No |
